items.title: Sinkhole near PNG's capital just one sign of water network crisis
items.description: A decades-old pipeline supplying water to nearly 1 million people in Papua New Guinea's capital is at risk of collapsing without urgent repairs, threatening to cut off more than half of the city's water supply.

items.title: Self-managed super sector blindsided by Labor-Greens deal on tax package
items.description: A ban on self-managed super funds borrowing money to buy housing has blindsided the sector, which says Labor should instead target "unscrupulous" operators spruiking property as an investment.

items.title: ASIC warns of 'extremely high' car loan fees amid rising complaints
items.description: A new report warns customers about traps they face when taking out a car loan, including high interest rates and fees.

items.title: Map to collect data to bridge gaps in suicide prevention, researchers say
items.description: Policymakers, mental health experts and those working on the front line will use the National Suicide Prevention Outcomes Map to gauge what services are working to prevent people from reaching critical crisis points.

items.title: 'Punched in the guts': Sacked academics take uni to Fair Work Commission
items.description: Two senior academics from Macquarie University allege they were targeted for redundancy because of their union activity.

items.title: Live: Ronaldo has two as Portugal bounces back emphatically against Uzbekistan
items.description: Cristiano Ronaldo returns to the field in Houston as Portugal takes on Uzbekistan after a disappointing FIFA World Cup opener. Later, England meets Ghana in Boston. Follow live.

items.title: Daryl Braithwaite announces end to live performances
items.description: Australian vocalist, former Sherbet frontman and ARIA Hall of Fame inductee Daryl Braithwaite says he is stepping back from singing live.

items.title: Senior Albanese minister clashes with Pocock over top-secret AI copyright claim
items.description: Federal politician David Pocock has clashed with a senior Albanese government minister over a whistleblower claim that federal cabinet is considering plans to let AI companies train on Australian copyright material.

items.title: Australians financially supporting family in Lebanon say they have no other option
items.description: Lebanese Australians, who have spent thousands of dollars to help their loved ones survive a two-and-a-half-year war, bear a financial burden that also comes with an emotional toll.

items.title: Court told alleged cult leader groomed girl to have 45 of his children
items.description: William "Little Pebble" Kamm has denied allegations he groomed a girl for more than a decade after he was accused of declaring in phone calls that it was her "mission" to become his queen.

items.title: Dead birds to be tested for H5N1 bird flu after washing up on SA coast
items.description: Two dead seabirds have been collected and are being tested for the H5N1 bird flu virus in South Australia, as well as another two wild birds in Western Australia, following Australia's first confirmed cases of the deadly variant this week.

items.title: Animals 'disappearing' from the wild as more people seek exotic pets
items.description: Australian and international authorities are "struggling" to keep up with regulating and policing the exotic pet market as demand surges.

items.title: Kids Helpline crisis interventions on the rise again towards COVID high
items.description: Kids Helpline says a growing number of Australian young people are requiring immediate emergency help, with a concerning trend around crisis interventions.

items.title: Australia approves restricted use of herbicide banned in 70 other countries
items.description: The Australian Pesticides and Veterinary Medicines Authority concludes its nearly 30-year review of the controversial but popular herbicide.

items.title: 'De-gayed for TV for 26 years': Gardening Australia star is proud to be out
items.description: Gardening Australia star Jerry Coleby-Williams hid his identity on TV for 26 years, but has never been ashamed of being a gay man.

items.title: Cosy ways to keep warm this winter without turning the heater on
items.description: Heating your whole house — or even a room — can be expensive in the depths of winter. Keeping the humans inside it warm is often cheaper and more efficient.

items.title: Quiz: Join us for a mid-week trip around the world
items.description: Which town would you be in if you were sunbathing at Cable Beach? Where does Maldon sea salt come from?

items.title: 'We lost our son': India's medical exams scandal leads to tragedy and uproar
items.description: More than 2 million students across India have resat the country's highly competitive medical entrance exam after last month's test was cancelled amid allegations that questions had been leaked.

items.title: Chihuahua Jet takes to the air as more pets allowed in cabin
items.description: An Australian airline is allowing small cats and dogs on a range of flights, with other passengers appearing unconcerned about sharing the plane with furry creatures.

items.title: 'They've been caught out': KPMG fallout continues with resignations
items.description: KPMG chair Martin Sheppard and two audit partners are leaving the accounting and consulting giant in the wake of a scandal over misuse of confidential client information and the alleged mistreatment of a whistleblower.

items.title: Newly discovered spider uses 'ballista' web to capture prey
items.description: A bizarre species of spider from the rainforests of Far North Queensland springs a nasty surprise.

items.title: Suspended Qld police officer facing an array of charges granted bail
items.description: A suspended Queensland police officer arrested over alleged offences against multiple women has been granted bail.

items.title: Video of nurse allegedly threatening Israelis excluded from court case
items.description: Lawyers argued the viral video clip from an online chat with an Israeli influencer breached NSW laws prohibiting recording private conversations without consent.

items.title: 'Look at us go!': First Nations actors celebrate Logies nods
items.description: With strong representation of Indigenous talent in this year's Logie Award nominations, actor Lila McGuire says it's a "very important time" and "a gift for young mob seeing so many of us excelling".

items.title: Who wins and who loses in the NSW budget
items.description: With billions for health but limited funds for the state's regions, here are the 2026 NSW budget's winners and losers.
